Method of Attack: Distributed through spam campaigns with malicious attachments containing macros or JavaScript that download Emotet DLL and load it using PowerShell
Attack Vector: Spam email campaigns using reply-chain phishing emails with malicious Word, Excel, and password-protected ZIP attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control servers listed by Abuse.ch (245 C2 servers)
PowerShell command downloading DLL from compromised WordPress site
Use of rundll32.exe to launch DLL
Spam emails with themes like missing wallet, CyberMonday sale, canceled meetings
